current_row.title: CycleVLA: Proactive Self-Correcting Vision-Language-Action Models via Subtask Backtracking and Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
current_row.org: University of Oxford; University of Cambridge
current_row.one_line: Predicts stop/progress as extra action dimensions; a VLM checks for failure near subtask ends, then backtracks and retries with MBR consensus over eight chunks. Simulation: LIBERO-Plus pi0.5 65.0% to 86.0%; LIBERO 96.9% to 98.5%.

current_row.title: V-VLAPS: Value-Guided Planning for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: An offline-trained value head guides Octo-prior MCTS using the LIBERO simulator. Matches value-free VLAPS at 600 seconds of search per episode; at 1800 seconds, adds 6 points on LIBERO-Object and 4 on LIBERO-10.

current_row.title: Real-world Reinforcement Learning from Suboptimal Interventions (SiLRI)
current_row.org: Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics and others
current_row.one_line: Per-state Lagrange multiplier keeps the policy near human interventions only where humans are consistent; reaches 90% at least 50% faster than HIL-SERL.

current_row.title: ReinforceGen: Hybrid Skill Policies with Automated Data Generation and Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Decomposes tasks into motion-planner-linked skills, imitates data generated from 10 human demos, then fine-tunes pose prediction, skills and termination with online adaptation and RL; over 80% on every Robosuite visuomotor task tested, 84.6% vs 44.7% for the HSP baseline.

current_row.title: EVOLVE-VLA: Test-Time Training from Environment Feedback for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Test-time GRPO with a pretrained progress critic (VLAC) instead of an oracle reward. LIBERO average 89.2 → 95.8 over the paper's own OpenVLA-OFT baseline; 1-shot SFT 43.6 → 61.3.

current_row.title: Symmetry-Aware Steering of Equivariant Diffusion Policies: Benefits and Limits
current_row.one_line: Equivariant noise-steering actor and critics on equivariant diffusion policies. Square D2 peak success: base 0.275, DSRL 0.552, Equi-DSRL 0.644; but strict equivariance was lowest on Stack D1 (0.728 vs DSRL 0.740). Plain DSRL's Q diverged in 3/5 Lift seeds.

current_row.title: Decoupled Q-Chunking
current_row.one_line: Long-chunk value backups train a distilled partial-chunk critic for a shorter-output policy. Across six hard offline goal-conditioned OGBench environments, aggregate score is 82 versus n-step 68, SHARSA 44 and Q-chunking 25.

current_row.title: Training Diffusion Policies via Prior-Mapping Co-Evolution
current_row.short: Training Diffusion Policies via Prior-Mapping Co-Evolution
current_row.one_line: GoRL: online RL for generative policies by optimizing a tractable latent prior, then consolidating into an expressive prior-to-action mapping; HopperStand return over 870, 3x strongest baseline (ICML 2026).

current_row.title: GR-RL: Going Dexterous and Precise for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Offline distributional chunk critics filter demonstrations, followed by mirror-symmetry augmentation and latent-noise online RL around a frozen base. Real shoe lacing improves from 45.7% for GR-3 behavior cloning to 83.3%.

current_row.title: Goal-Driven Reward by Video Diffusion Models for Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Fine-tunes a pretrained video diffusion model to generate goal videos; rewards combine video-level latent alignment with them and a forward-backward-representation reward toward a CLIP-selected goal frame; evaluated on Meta-World and Distracting Control Suite.

current_row.title: Discover, Learn, and Reinforce: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Pretraining with Diverse RL-Generated Trajectories
current_row.one_line: DLR makes RL generate multiple distinct high-success behavior patterns per task for VLA pretraining; beats equal-sized standard-RL data downstream and scales positively where single-pattern RL data does not.

current_row.title: SpeedAug: Policy Acceleration via Tempo-Enriched Policy and RL Fine-Tuning
current_row.one_line: Tempo-augmented demonstrations and discounted sparse rewards optimize policy speed. DPPO handles simulation; real-arm PA-RL increases pick-and-place throughput from 11.4 to 20.76 successes/min after 16 minutes of interaction (v2 result).

current_row.title: SRPO: Self-Referential Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Scores failed rollouts by V-JEPA 2 latent distance to the batch's own successes and uses these rewards in a GRPO-style update; one-shot OpenVLA* on LIBERO goes from 48.9% to 99.2% average success.

current_row.title: Towards Deploying VLA without Fine-Tuning: Plug-and-Play Inference-Time VLA Policy Steering via Embodied Evolutionary Diffusion (VLA-Pilot)
current_row.one_line: GPT-4o writes a keypoint scoring function, then evolutionary search with truncated re-noising inside a diffusion VLA's samples. Real DiVLA 0.31 → 0.62.

current_row.title: Scalable Policy Evaluation with Video World Models
current_row.one_line: Action-conditioned Cosmos-Predict2 evaluator. Sim Pearson 0.833-0.879; real Bridge only 0.687. Adding other policies' rollouts to world-model training matters.

current_row.title: Diffusion Policies with Value-Conditional Optimization for Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: DIVO (IROS 2025): trains a diffusion behavior model with binary advantage-based loss weights, then regularizes a TD3+BC actor toward diffusion samples with non-negative advantage; reports gains on D4RL locomotion and AntMaze.

current_row.title: The Path Not Taken: RLVR Provably Learns Off the Principals
current_row.one_line: Three-Gate Theory for LLM RL with verifiable rewards: sparse-looking updates are a model-conditioned bias landing off principal weight directions with minimal spectral drift, unlike SFT.

current_row.title: ExpReS-VLA: Specializing Vision-Language-Action Models Through Experience Replay and Retrieval
current_row.one_line: Frozen-feature success/failure buffers, retrieval-augmented LoRA BC and a contrastive loss on failures. Real ID: naive FT 84.7% → 98.0%; OOD: 32% → 98%.

current_row.title: Real-to-Sim Robot Policy Evaluation with Gaussian Splatting Simulation of Soft-Body Interactions
current_row.one_line: PhysTwin spring-mass twins plus Gaussian-splat rendering. Sim vs real success of ACT/DP/pi0/SmolVLA checkpoints correlates at Pearson r 0.944 / 0.901 / 0.915 on toy packing / rope routing / T-block pushing.

current_row.title: Learning Without Critics? Revisiting GRPO in Classical Reinforcement Learning Environments
current_row.short: Learning Without Critics? Revisiting GRPO in Classical Reinforcement Learning Environments
current_row.one_line: Benchmarks critic-free GRPO against PPO on classical control: all critic-free baselines underperform PPO except on short-horizon tasks like CartPole; high discount factors mostly help; smaller group sizes outperform larger ones.

current_row.title: RL without TD learning
current_row.one_line: Transitive RL: divide-and-conquer off-policy value learning over in-dataset subgoals with expectile regression; matches best TD-n on OGBench long-horizon (up to 3,000-step) goal-conditioned tasks without tuning n.

current_row.title: End-to-End Dexterous Arm-Hand VLA Policies via Shared Autonomy: VR Teleoperation Augmented by Autonomous Hand VLA Policy for Efficient Data Collection
current_row.short: End-to-End Dexterous Arm-Hand VLA Policies via Shared Autonomy: VR Teleoperation…
current_row.one_line: Shared autonomy combines human VR arm control with a tactile DexGrasp-VLA hand policy; collected data and corrective teleoperation train an end-to-end arm-hand VLA. Real pick-and-place across 50 objects: 88.7% success, averaging seen and unseen objects.

current_row.title: On-Policy Distillation
current_row.one_line: Student samples its trajectories; teacher supplies per-token reverse-KL feedback. Thinking Machines estimates 9–30x lower cost than extrapolated off-policy SFT for raising Qwen3-8B-Base from 60% to 70% on AIME 2024.

current_row.title: Transitive RL: Value Learning via Divide and Conquer
current_row.one_line: Divide-and-conquer value update for offline goal-conditioned RL built on the triangle inequality; in principle needs O(log T) recursions versus TD's O(T), reducing bias accumulation; best results on long-horizon benchmarks. ICLR 2026.

current_row.title: GSWorld: Closed-Loop Photo-Realistic Simulation Suite for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: 3DGS plus ManiSkill3 photoreal twin for evaluation and DAgger. Sim underestimates real in all 8 ACT/pi0 cells. Sim-collected DAgger, evaluated on the real FR3: 63.75% vs 55% training from scratch at iteration 5 (4-task average).

current_row.title: Using Non-Expert Data to Robustify Imitation Learning via Offline Reinforcement Learning (RISE: Robust Imitation by Stitching from Experts)
current_row.one_line: Offline IDQL with binary expert/non-expert rewards, a spectral-norm penalty and DINOv2-neighbor action augmentation widens the behavior policy to stitch play/failure data. Real lampshade: BC 17.5%, plain IDQL 10.0%, RISE 82.5%.

current_row.title: Adversarial Fine-tuning in Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Robust Robot Control
current_row.short: Adversarial Fine-tuning in Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Robust Robot…
current_row.one_line: Offline-pretrained policies fine-tuned online with injected action perturbations under an EMA-based performance-aware curriculum; more robust than offline-only and faster than scratch on locomotion.

current_row.title: The Art of Scaling Reinforcement Learning Compute for LLMs
current_row.short: The Art of Scaling Reinforcement Learning Compute for LLMs
current_row.one_line: 400k+ GPU-hour study fitting sigmoidal compute-performance curves to LLM RL: recipes differ in asymptote, while details like loss aggregation, normalization and curriculum mainly change compute efficiency; ScaleRL predictably extrapolates to a 100k GPU-hour run.

current_row.title: RoVer: Robot Reward Model as Test-Time Verifier for Vision-Language-Action Model
current_row.one_line: A process reward model trained on perturbed expert actions scores candidates and predicts local-search directions. Real dual-arm Dobot with a Diffusion Policy base: 72.9% to 88.6% success across seven conditions with ten trials each.

current_row.title: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching Policies for Vision-Language-Action Models (FPO for pi0)
current_row.one_line: Freezes the pi0 decoder; trains a latent flow actor with a CFM-loss ratio proxy, PPO clipping and a Q-ensemble. LIBERO average 87.2 (no plain-pi0 row). One-task ablation, SAC replacing the ratio proxy: 32.4 vs 78.5 (ICRA 2026).

current_row.title: Failure Prediction at Runtime for Generative Robot Policies (FIPER)
current_row.one_line: Failure detection combines RND out-of-distribution scores with action-chunk entropy, calibrated on successes. Time-varying thresholds achieve accuracy 0.78 and TWA 0.65; the CP-band variant with a false-alarm bound achieves TWA 0.62.

current_row.title: DEAS: DEtached value learning with Action Sequence for Scalable Offline RL
current_row.one_line: Offline RL with action-sequence critics (SMDP Q-learning) plus detached value learning to curb overestimation; beats baselines on OGBench and boosts VLAs on RoboCasa Kitchen and real-world manipulation.

current_row.title: A Survey of Process Reward Models: From Outcome Signals to Process Supervisions for Large Language Models
current_row.short: A Survey of Process Reward Models
current_row.one_line: Survey of step-level process reward models for LLMs: process data generation, PRM construction, use in test-time scaling and RL; applications span math, code, multimodal, robotics, agents.

current_row.title: Value Flows
current_row.one_line: Flow-matching model of the return distribution trained with distributional TD; 1.3x average success gain over 62 tasks.

current_row.title: Group Policy Gradient
current_row.one_line: Critic-free policy gradient (GPG) replacing the value function with a group-based Monte Carlo advantage estimator inside PPO's clipped objective; matches or beats PPO and uses parallel simulation better.

current_row.title: A Recipe for Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer in Manipulation with Online Imitation-Pretrained World Models
current_row.org: UC San Diego, UC Berkeley, UNC Chapel Hill, Sudo AI
current_row.one_line: Reward-free online imitation RL pretrains a TD-MPC2-style world model in sim for coverage, then a 15-30 demo real fine-tune. Real 32/40 vs 15/40 for the best baseline (v2 numbers; v1 differed).

current_row.title: VLA-RFT: Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Fine-tuning with Verified Rewards in World Simulators
current_row.org: Westlake University; Zhejiang University; OpenHelix; Fudan;…
current_row.one_line: GRPO for a flow VLA against a 138M world model with 'verified' reward (distance to the world model's rendering of the expert). LIBERO 86.6 → 91.1 in 400 steps.

current_row.title: VLA Model Post-Training via Action-Chunked PPO and Self Behavior Cloning
current_row.short: VLA Model Post-Training via Action-Chunked PPO and Self Behavior Cloning
current_row.one_line: Action-chunked PPO plus auxiliary self-BC loss on a dynamically refreshed buffer of high-quality self-collected trials; 0.93 success and 42.17 steps-to-success on MetaWorld, beating supervised fine-tuning.

current_row.title: TimeRewarder: Learning Dense Reward from Passive Videos via Frame-wise Temporal Distance
current_row.org: Tsinghua, Shanghai Qi Zhi, SJTU, UPenn
current_row.one_line: Learns signed frame-pair temporal distances from action-free videos as a dense progress reward; added to the sparse success signal for DrQ-v2, it reaches near-perfect success on 9/10 Meta-World tasks within 200k interactions (sim).

current_row.title: SAC Flow: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Flow-Based Policies via Velocity-Reparameterized Sequential Modeling
current_row.org: Tsinghua, CMU, Li Auto, Shanghai AI Lab
current_row.one_line: Treats flow sampling as a residual recurrent computation; GRU-style gated Flow-G or Transformer-decoded Flow-T stabilize direct SAC training. Reports up to 130% improvement on from-scratch MuJoCo HumanoidStandup.

current_row.title: XQC: Well-conditioned Optimization Accelerates Deep Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: SAC-based actor-critic whose BatchNorm + WeightNorm + distributional cross-entropy critic cuts condition numbers by orders of magnitude; SOTA sample efficiency on 55 proprioceptive and 15 vision tasks with fewer parameters.

current_row.title: SARM: Stage-Aware Reward Modeling for Long Horizon Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Stage-aware progress labels from subtask segmentation; reward-weighted BC on pi0 gets 10/12 medium and 8/12 hard T-shirt folds vs 1/12 and 0/12 for plain BC on the full dataset; available in LeRobot.

current_row.title: World-Env: Leveraging World Model as a Virtual Environment for VLA Post-Training
current_row.one_line: RLOO+PPO for OpenVLA-OFT inside a video simulator with a VLM reflector. LIBERO 5-demo average 74.85 → 79.6, about equal to RIPT-VLA in the real simulator.

current_row.title: DexFlyWheel: A Scalable and Self-improving Data Generation Framework for Dexterous Manipulation
current_row.org: Harbin Institute of Technology, Peking University, PsiBot,…
current_row.one_line: Freezes a diffusion imitation policy, trains a SAC residual scaled by 0.1 with shaped rewards, then filters successful rollouts, augments them and retrains imitation policies in a simulation data-generation loop.

current_row.title: VLA-Reasoner: Empowering Vision-Language-Action Models with Reasoning via Online Monte Carlo Tree Search
current_row.one_line: MCTS with a KDE action prior, a video world model and a progress value on a frozen VLA. LIBERO OpenVLA 76.0 → 81.0; real OpenVLA 22% → 41%.

current_row.title: Beyond Human Demonstrations: Diffusion-Based Reinforcement Learning to Generate Data for VLA Training
current_row.one_line: Diffusion-policy RL autonomously generates LIBERO training data; a VLA trained on it reaches 81.9% average success, +5.3 over human demos and +12.6 over Gaussian-RL data.

current_row.title: Selective Progress-Aware Querying for Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: Selective Progress-Aware Querying for Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: SPARQ: query policy requests human feedback only when learning stagnates or worsens; near-perfect success on simulated UR5 cube picking (PyBullet) with about half the always-query feedback budget.

current_row.title: Generalizable Domain Adaptation for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
current_row.short: Generalizable Domain Adaptation for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
current_row.one_line: Unbalanced optimal-transport loss aligns joint observation-action features across abundant sim and scarce real demos during BC co-training; up to ~30% real-world success gain (NeurIPS 2025).

current_row.title: World4RL: Diffusion World Models for Policy Refinement with Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: PPO inside a diffusion world model trained on demos plus policy and random rollouts. Real Franka 68.3% → 93.3% (DP 88.3%).

current_row.title: SOE: Sample-Efficient Robot Policy Self-Improvement via On-Manifold Exploration
current_row.one_line: Information-bottleneck latent exploration for iterated success-filtered BC. Real Toaster Load 0.56 → 0.75 (0.84 with human steering) in one round.

current_row.title: Self-Improving Embodied Foundation Models
current_row.one_line: REINFORCE with a steps-to-go head that serves as both shaped reward and success detector. Real LanguageTable ~62-63% → ~87-88% with ~3% extra episodes (NeurIPS 2025).

current_row.title: floq: Training Critics via Flow-Matching for Scaling Compute in Value-Based RL
current_row.one_line: Trains a flow-matching Q-function with TD targets; more integration steps increase critic computation. Best configuration reaches about 1.8x FQL on hard OGBench offline tasks, with separate gains in online fine-tuning.

current_row.title: Learn from What We HAVE: History-Aware VErifier that Reasons about Past Interactions Online
current_row.one_line: Decouples generation from verification: a diffusion model proposes candidate actions and a history-aware verifier selects using past interactions, handling ambiguous articulated objects, multi-modal doors, uneven pick-up. CoRL 2025.

current_row.title: Compute-Optimal Scaling for Value-Based Deep RL
current_row.short: Compute-Optimal Scaling for Value-Based Deep RL
current_row.one_line: Studies compute allocation across model size, batch size and UTD ratio in online value-based RL; identifies TD-overfitting, where large batches hurt small critics but not large ones.

current_row.title: Improving Pre-Trained Vision-Language-Action Policies with Model-Based Search (VLAPS)
current_row.one_line: MCTS uses Octo action priors and the LIBERO simulator as an assumed accurate environment model. Simulation only: at the 50k-step Octo checkpoint, LIBERO-Object success rises from 6% to 73% over Octo alone.

current_row.title: Actor-Critic for Continuous Action Chunks: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Sparse Reward (AC3)
current_row.one_line: TD3-style actor-critic over 16-action chunks with success-only actor updates; BiGym average 0.465 vs CQN-AS 0.349.

current_row.title: IRL-VLA: Training an Vision-Language-Action Policy via Reward World Model
current_row.one_line: Driving VLA: imitation pretraining, then PPO fine-tuning against a lightweight inverse-RL reward world model instead of a simulator; top NAVSIM v2 results, 2nd in CVPR2025 Autonomous Grand Challenge.

current_row.title: Genie Envisioner: A Unified World Foundation Platform for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: One video world model platform for policy (GE-Act), simulation and closed-loop evaluation (GE-Sim), trained on about 3,000 h of teleop.

current_row.title: DiWA: Diffusion Policy Adaptation with World Models
current_row.one_line: DPPO inside a frozen RSSM trained on play data, with no physical interaction during fine-tuning. CALVIN simulation skills gain roughly 17-41 points over the base policy (close-drawer 59.14% to 91.95%).

current_row.title: D2PPO: Diffusion Policy Policy Optimization with Dispersive Loss
current_row.one_line: Dispersive-loss regularization (in-batch representations as negatives) during diffusion-policy pre-training, then DPPO fine-tuning. RoboMimic average success 0.94 vs 0.86 for DPPO (Transport 0.87 vs 0.60); real Franka Transport 70% vs 45% (AAAI 2026).

current_row.title: CO-RFT: Efficient Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language-Action Models through Chunked Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Behavior cloning on 30–60 demos precedes offline chunked Cal-QL with a Transformer critic. Across six real dexterous-hand grasping tasks, reports 57% average success-rate improvement over SFT; absolute versus relative change is unstated.

current_row.title: Flow Matching Policy Gradients (Flow Policy Optimization, FPO)
current_row.one_line: PPO ratio = exp(L_CFM_old - L_CFM_new), with no likelihoods. DM Control average 759.3 vs 667.8 for Gaussian PPO and 652.5 for DPPO.

current_row.title: Latent Policy Steering with Embodiment-Agnostic Pretrained World Models
current_row.one_line: Cross-embodiment-pretrained Dreamer world model plus critic ranks BC chunks. Real Franka, 30-50 demos: BC 21.2% → 36.2%.

current_row.title: Action Chunking and Exploratory Data Collection Yield Exponential Improvements in Behavior Cloning for Continuous Control
current_row.short: Action Chunking and Exploratory Data Collection Yield Exponential Improvements in…
current_row.one_line: Control-theoretic analysis showing action chunking and exploratory (noise-injected) data collection each circumvent exponential compounding error in behavior cloning, in different regimes; validated on robot learning benchmarks.

current_row.title: Penalizing Infeasible Actions and Reward Scaling in Reinforcement Learning with Offline Data (PARS)
current_row.short: Penalizing Infeasible Actions and Reward Scaling in Reinforcement Learning with Offline…
current_row.one_line: Reward scaling with layer norm plus penalizing infeasible actions curbs Q-function extrapolation; strong offline and offline-to-online D4RL results, notably AntMaze Ultra (ICML 2025 spotlight).

current_row.title: Online Pre-Training for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: Online Pre-Training for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: OPT adds an online pre-training phase that trains a new value function tailored for online fine-tuning; average 30% improvement on D4RL (MuJoCo, Antmaze, Adroit) with TD3/SPOT. ICML 2025.

current_row.title: RLRC: Reinforcement Learning-based Recovery for Compressed Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Structured pruning of a VLA, recovery via SFT then RL (critic warm-up, BC-loss regularization), then quantization: up to 8x memory reduction, 2.3x speedup at original success rate.

current_row.title: Compliant Residual DAgger: Improving Real-World Contact-Rich Manipulation with Human Corrections (CR-DAgger)
current_row.one_line: Compliant physical delta corrections train a force-aware residual on a frozen diffusion policy; real book flipping 40% to 100% success with on-policy delta data.

current_row.title: Steering Your Diffusion Policy with Latent Space Reinforcement Learning (DSRL)
current_row.one_line: RL over the input noise of a frozen diffusion or flow policy. Real Franka 2/10 → 9/10 after about 40 episodes. Real pi0 'turn on toaster' 5/20 → 18/20 after 80 episodes.

current_row.title: DynaGuide: Steering Diffusion Policies with Active Dynamic Guidance
current_row.one_line: A DINOv2-space dynamics model's gradient guides a frozen diffusion policy toward goal images. CALVIN articulated parts 70% average, 8.7x over base.

current_row.title: SAFE: Multitask Failure Detection for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: A tiny failure-detector head on frozen VLA hidden states; unseen-task ROC-AUC 78.00 vs 73.93 for the best baseline in sim.

current_row.title: Self-Improving Loops for Visual Robotic Planning (SILVR)
current_row.one_line: Video-generative planner (optionally composed with an internet-pretrained video model) iteratively fine-tuned on its own success-filtered rollouts; improves over iterations on unseen MetaWorld and two real-arm tasks, and still improves with VLM-judged filtering or suboptimal initial data (ICLR 2026).

current_row.title: A Smooth Sea Never Made a Skilled SAILOR: Robust Imitation via Learning to Search
current_row.one_line: MPPI residual search in a learned world model with an IRL reward and critic, then distillation. Sim only; e.g. Square 0.29 → 0.78 at 50 demos.

current_row.title: Horizon Reduction Makes RL Scalable
current_row.one_line: Many offline RL methods saturate despite datasets up to 1,000x larger than typical. Horizon-reduction experiments improve scaling on challenging tasks; SHARSA achieves the best asymptotic performance among the evaluated methods.

current_row.title: WorldGym: World Model as An Environment for Policy Evaluation (earlier/code title: "Evaluating Robot Policies in a World Model")
current_row.one_line: Video world model plus GPT-4o judge as a policy evaluator. Pearson r = 0.78 vs real over 17 Bridge tasks.

current_row.title: ProRL: Prolonged Reinforcement Learning Expands Reasoning Boundaries in Large Language Models
current_row.one_line: Prolonged RL adds KL control, reference-policy resets and diverse tasks to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B. Pass@k gains are largest where the base is weak; some high-baseline math tasks show unchanged or lower pass@128.

current_row.title: The Entropy Mechanism of Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models
current_row.short: The Entropy Mechanism of Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models
current_row.one_line: Shows LLM policy-gradient RL trades policy entropy for performance, driven by probability-logit covariance; Clip-Cov and KL-Cov restrict high-covariance token updates to prevent entropy collapse.

current_row.title: SCIZOR: A Self-Supervised Approach to Data Curation for Large-Scale Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: A task-progress predictor removes suboptimal state-action pairs; deduplication removes redundant pairs. On Sirius-Fleet real-robot tasks, the paper text reports a 32.9-percentage-point success gain over training on the full dataset.

current_row.title: Hume: Introducing System-2 Thinking in Visual-Language-Action Model
current_row.org: Shanghai AI Lab; SJTU; Fudan; INSAIT
current_row.one_line: pi0-style VLA with a built-in value-query head that picks among 5 partly denoised chunks, plus a fast refiner. LIBERO 98.6% vs pi0 94.2%.

current_row.title: RFTF: Reinforcement Fine-tuning for Embodied Agents with Temporal Feedback
current_row.one_line: A temporal-ranking value model as potential-based shaping in PPO; CALVIN ABC-D Avg. Len. 4.283 to 4.296 (Seer-Large), while a sparse-reward PPO ablation fell below the starting policy (4.225).

current_row.title: What Can RL Bring to VLA Generalization? An Empirical Study
current_row.short: RL4VLA (What Can RL Bring to VLA Generalization?)
current_row.one_line: Controlled study where PPO beats GRPO and DPO. ID 0.781 (SFT-16k, plateaued) → 0.938. Robot-pose OOD 0.339 → 0.797. Zero-shot Franka pick-and-place 0.00 → 0.27.

current_row.title: WorldEval: World Model as Real-World Robot Policies Evaluator
current_row.org: Midea Group; East China Normal University
current_row.one_line: Conditions Wan 2.1 14B on the policy's own latent (Policy2Vec). Average r 0.942 vs 0.411 for a real-to-sim baseline.

current_row.title: Genie Centurion: Accelerating Scalable Real-World Robot Training with Human Rewind-and-Refine Guidance
current_row.one_line: Rewind-and-refine DAgger on the GO-1 VLA with a learned success detector; e.g. Microwave-Heating task score 0.97±0.01 at 80 trajectories vs 0.55±0.05 teleop.

current_row.title: VLA-RL: Towards Masterful and General Robotic Manipulation with Scalable Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: PPO on OpenVLA-7B, treating a trajectory as a multi-turn conversation, with a VLM process reward model trained on automatically extracted pseudo-labels. LIBERO average 76.5 → 81.0 (OpenVLA SFT baseline); π0-FAST, listed for reference, scores 85.5.

current_row.title: FlowQ: Energy-Guided Flow Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Energy-guided flow matching learns a Q-guided velocity field during training, needing no inference-time guidance; policy training time is constant in flow sampling steps, with competitive offline RL performance.

current_row.title: RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction
current_row.one_line: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL diagnoses failures and corrects VLA actions, using 9,440 failed trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs. Failure-analysis score: 79.10 versus GPT-4o 57.42; real SO-100 success after five attempts: 61.25% versus 47.5% without correction.

current_row.title: Reinforcement Learning Finetunes Small Subnetworks in Large Language Models
current_row.short: Reinforcement Learning Finetunes Small Subnetworks in Large Language Models
current_row.one_line: Across 7 RL algorithms (PPO, GRPO, DPO...) and 10 LLMs, RL fine-tuning updates only 5-30% of parameters; these sparse updates are nearly full-rank. NeurIPS 2025.

current_row.title: DataMIL: Selecting Data for Robot Imitation Learning with Datamodels
current_row.one_line: Linear datamodels with a target-demo BC-loss proxy select prior-data clusters. LIBERO-10 37.76 vs 27.72 for all-data co-training.

current_row.title: ReinboT: Amplifying Robot Visual-Language Manipulation with Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: End-to-end VLA that predicts dense returns to capture data-quality distribution and act toward maximized return; SOTA on CALVIN mixed-quality data, strong few-shot and real-world OOD generalization.

current_row.title: What Matters for Batch Online Reinforcement Learning in Robotics?
current_row.one_line: Controlled study of deploy-collect-retrain loops; implicit Q best-of-N extraction beats AWR (Square: AWR 62 → 11 vs best-of-N 47 → 83).

current_row.title: X-Sim: Cross-Embodiment Learning via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
current_row.one_line: Reconstructs a photorealistic sim from an RGBD human video, trains RL on object-centric rewards, distills into an image diffusion policy with online sim-real alignment; no teleoperation data. Average task progress +30% over hand-tracking and sim-to-real baselines on 5 real tasks.

current_row.title: SIME: Enhancing Policy Self-Improvement with Modal-level Exploration
current_row.one_line: Success-filtered self-improvement with noise injected into the observation embedding to diversify modes. Square-20 (state): 0.534 → 0.620 vs 0.556 for plain self-improvement.

current_row.title: Does Reinforcement Learning Really Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model?
current_row.short: Does Reinforcement Learning Really Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the…
current_row.org: Tsinghua University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University
current_row.one_line: RLVR-trained LLMs win at pass@1 but base models win at large-k pass@k: RL improves sampling efficiency within base-model capability, unlike distillation; NeurIPS 2025 Oral.

current_row.title: Welcome to the Era of Experience
current_row.short: Welcome to the Era of Experience
current_row.one_line: Position essay (preprint chapter of MIT Press book "Designing an Intelligence"): agents will gain superhuman ability by learning predominantly from their own experience via streams, grounded actions, grounded rewards, and planning.

current_row.title: Real-is-Sim: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap with a Dynamic Digital Twin
current_row.one_line: The policy always acts on a synced dynamic digital twin. Failure states mined in sim plus 30 new demos lift real PushT from about 57% to 80%.

current_row.title: HACTS: a Human-As-Copilot Teleoperation System for Robot Learning
current_row.one_line: Low-cost, 3D-printed bilateral teleoperation system that syncs leader hardware with robot joints so humans can seamlessly intervene and collect correction data; improves imitation learning and human-in-the-loop RL.

current_row.title: Sim-and-Real Co-Training: A Simple Recipe for Vision-Based Robotic Manipulation
current_row.org: UT Austin, NVIDIA, UC Berkeley, New York University
current_row.one_line: Co-trains one Diffusion Policy on 20-50 real demos per task plus MimicGen-multiplied sim 'digital cousins' and prior sim data. Across six real tasks, average success rose from 45.3% (real only) to 83.2% (real + cousins + prior).

current_row.title: 1000 Layer Networks for Self-Supervised RL: Scaling Depth Can Enable New Goal-Reaching Capabilities
current_row.one_line: Scaling contrastive goal-conditioned RL from 4 to 64 layers gives 2–50x gains on simulated tasks without demonstrations or rewards; Humanoid U-Maze improves further up to 1,024 layers.

current_row.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
current_row.one_line: Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization: four techniques for large-scale LLM RL; 50 points on AIME 2024 with Qwen2.5-32B; code on verl plus dataset released.

current_row.title: MoRE: Unlocking Scalability in Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts quadruped VLA fine-tuned with an RL objective on mixed-quality data; outperforms baselines across six skills, generalizes OOD, validated on real robot (ICRA 2025).

current_row.title: Refined Policy Distillation: From VLA Generalists to RL Experts
current_row.one_line: A small PPO student plus an MSE term toward a frozen VLA teacher's action. Even 1-10% success teachers make sparse-reward PPO work in ManiSkill3 (sim only).

current_row.title: Curating Demonstrations using Online Experience (Demo-SCORE)
current_row.one_line: A success classifier trained on policy rollouts flags demonstration strategies the policy cannot execute. Robomimic square peg (simulation, averaged over data mixtures): 79.9% base to 94.4%.

current_row.title: Chunking the Critic: A Transformer-based Soft Actor-Critic with N-Step Returns (T-SAC)
current_row.one_line: Transformer critic over action prefixes trained with N-step returns without importance sampling; Box-Pushing dense 96.8% vs baselines at or below 85%.

current_row.title: Multi-Stage Manipulation with Demonstration-Augmented Reward, Policy, and World Model Learning (DEMO3)
current_row.org: UC San Diego, Hillbot, ETH Zürich
current_row.one_line: Demonstration-augmented model-based RL (TD-MPC2 backbone) that learns stage-wise dense rewards online alongside policy and world model; 40% better average data efficiency (70% on the hardest tasks) than baselines across 16 simulated sparse-reward tasks, using 5-100 demos per task.

current_row.title: Uncertainty Comes for Free: Human-in-the-Loop Policies with Diffusion Models
current_row.one_line: Computes uncertainty from a diffusion policy's own denoising process to request operator help only when needed at deployment; the same signal targets data collection for fine-tuning.

current_row.title: Re3Sim: Generating High-Fidelity Simulation Data via 3D-Photorealistic Real-to-Sim for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Real-to-sim pipeline using 3D reconstruction and neural rendering inside a physics simulator; imitation policies trained only on its sim data exceed 58% average zero-shot real success.

current_row.title: Robot Data Curation with Mutual Information Estimators (DemInf)
current_row.one_line: Label-free demo scoring by contribution to I(S;A), using k-NN estimators in VAE latents. The abstract reports a 5-10% improvement on RoboMimic.

current_row.title: From Action Labels to Sets: Rethinking Action Supervision for Imitation Learning from Corrective Feedback (CLIC)
current_row.one_line: CLIC: builds set-valued desired-action targets from human corrections and trains the policy to put probability mass on those sets, giving robustness to noisy corrections and multi-modal behaviors.

current_row.title: Value-Based Deep RL Scales Predictably
current_row.one_line: Fits power laws relating batch size and learning rate to UTD and predicts data/compute trade-offs from small runs; evaluates off-policy value-based RL with SAC, BRO and PQL.

current_row.title: Learning from Active Human Involvement through Proxy Value Propagation (PVP)
current_row.one_line: Reward-free +1/-1 proxy values on human vs rejected actions; MetaDrive test success 0.857 vs HG-DAgger 0.045 (NeurIPS 2023, arXiv 2025).

current_row.title: DIME: Diffusion-Based Maximum Entropy Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Derives a tractable lower bound on the MaxEnt RL objective for diffusion policies with provably convergent policy iteration; outperforms other diffusion-RL methods on high-dimensional control benchmarks.

current_row.title: Rapidly Adapting Policies to the Real World via Simulation-Guided Fine-Tuning (SGFT)
current_row.one_line: Precursor. The frozen sim critic serves as a potential-based shaping reward and H-step terminal value for real-world SAC/TD-MPC2. 100% on hammering and pushing within about an hour, 70% on insertion within two hours.

current_row.title: From Foresight to Forethought: VLM-In-the-Loop Policy Steering via Latent Alignment (FOREWARN)
current_row.one_line: Latent world model plus fine-tuned VLM verify 6 plan modes in language. Real Franka Fork task 0.10 → 0.70.

current_row.title: Inference-Time Enhancement of Generative Robot Policies via Predictive World Modeling (GPC: Generative Predictive Control; v1 titled "Strengthening Generative Robot Policies through Predictive World Modeling")
current_row.one_line: World model plus reward predictor rank diffusion-policy chunks. State Push-T 0.812 → 0.934 (K=5000); vision Push-T 0.642 → 0.739 vs V-GPS 0.620.

current_row.title: Improving Vision-Language-Action Model with Online Reinforcement Learning (iRe-VLA)
current_row.one_line: Alternates online RL on an action head over a frozen VLM with full-model SFT on expert demos and RL successes. MetaWorld unseen-10 success: 0.51 SFT / 0.39 PPO-Replay / 0.80 iRe-VLA.

current_row.title: Policy Decorator: Model-Agnostic Online Refinement for Large Policy Model
current_row.one_line: Bounded SAC residual plus a progressive exploration schedule on frozen BeT or Diffusion Policy. Bases at 15-78% reach near-perfect success on 8 sim tasks, with millions of env steps.

current_row.title: RLDG: Robotic Generalist Policy Distillation via Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Real-world HIL-SERL specialists generate successful rollouts that become SFT data for OpenVLA/Octo. OpenVLA +33% on FMB Insertion vs fine-tuning on human demos.

current_row.title: Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning Need Not Retain Offline Data (WSRL: Warm-Start RL)
current_row.one_line: Drop offline data, warm up with frozen-policy rollouts, then high-UTD RL; real Franka peg insertion 13/20 → 20/20 in 18 min, while SERL/RLPD was at 0/20 after 50 min.

current_row.title: GRAPE: Generalizing Robot Policy via Preference Alignment
current_row.org: UNC-Chapel Hill; University of Washington; University of Chicago
current_row.one_line: Trajectory-level preference optimization aligns OpenVLA using its successful and failed rollouts, ranked by task success, self-evaluation and VLM-generated stage/keypoint costs, with a KL anchor to the SFT reference policy.

current_row.title: PROGRESSOR: A Perceptually Guided Reward Estimator with Self-Supervised Online Refinement
current_row.one_line: Predicts a Gaussian over task progress from initial, current and goal frames, pretrained on EPIC-KITCHENS video; during online RL, adversarial 'push-back' lowers estimates on the agent's own out-of-distribution rollouts to counter distribution shift.

current_row.title: Vision Language Models are In-Context Value Learners (Generative Value Learning, GVL)
current_row.one_line: Asks a frozen VLM (Gemini-1.5-Pro) for task progress on shuffled frames, zero- or few-shot; introduces VOC (0.74 on RT-1); one-shot GVL-weighted AWR beat diffusion policy on 4 of 7 real ALOHA tasks (1 tie, 2 losses).

current_row.title: So You Think You Can Scale Up Autonomous Robot Data Collection?
current_row.short: So You Think You Can Scale Up Autonomous Robot Data Collection?
current_row.one_line: CoRL 2024 study over 7 sim and real tasks: autonomous imitation-learning data collection inherits RL's environment-design burdens; scaling human demos often improves policies significantly more.

current_row.title: CHG-DAgger: Interactive Imitation Learning with Human-Policy Cooperative Control
current_row.org: Toyota Motor Corporation; Toyota Research Institute
current_row.one_line: Cooperative HG-DAgger uses multilateral control so a human and learned visuomotor policy can correct task failures together without a full control handoff.

current_row.title: Multi-Task Interactive Robot Fleet Learning with Visual World Models (Sirius-Fleet)
current_row.one_line: World-model-based failure monitor decides when humans step in; real autonomous success 0.250 to 0.715 over 3 rounds.

current_row.title: Precise and Dexterous Robotic Manipulation via Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning (HIL-SERL)
current_row.one_line: RLPD with human SpaceMouse corrections and a learned binary reward classifier, trained on real robots. RAM insertion: 100% after 1.5 h vs 29% for a data-matched HG-DAgger baseline; faster cycle times on every timed task.

current_row.title: On-Robot Reinforcement Learning with Goal-Contrastive Rewards (GCR)
current_row.one_line: A VIP-style progress embedding kept honest with hard negatives from the agent's own failed episodes; solves about twice as many tasks as baseline reward learners.

current_row.title: SPIRE: Synergistic Planning, Imitation, and Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Manipulation
current_row.one_line: TAMP decomposes tasks into short segments; BC policies receive RL fine-tuning with a KL penalty. Across nine simulated tasks, average success is 87.8% versus 52.9% for TAMP-gated BC and 37.6% for planner-guided RL.

current_row.title: Diff-DAgger: Uncertainty Estimation with Diffusion Policy for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Diffusion training loss triggers human queries in robot-gated DAgger; reports 39.0% higher failure-prediction F1 and 20.6% task-completion improvement over evaluated baselines, with 7.8x lower average policy-update time than Ensemble-DAgger.

current_row.title: Steering Your Generalists: Improving Robotic Foundation Models via Value Guidance (V-GPS)
current_row.one_line: Offline Cal-QL Q reranks K samples from frozen generalists. Real WidowX Octo-small-1.5 0.24 → 0.44 (+82%); SIMPLER gains are small for some policies (OpenVLA 0.24 → 0.27).

current_row.title: TOP-ERL: Transformer-based Off-Policy Episodic Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Enables off-policy updates for episodic RL by segmenting long action sequences and valuing each segment with a transformer critic and n-step returns; ICLR 2025 Spotlight.

current_row.title: Automated Creation of Digital Cousins for Robust Policy Learning (ACDC)
current_row.one_line: Precursor. Sim 'cousin' scenes built from one image. Zero-shot real door opening: 25% for the exact twin vs 90% cousin-only and 95% twin+cousin.

current_row.title: Incremental Learning for Robot Shared Autonomy
current_row.short: Incremental Learning for Robot Shared Autonomy
current_row.org: Carnegie Mellon University; NIST; University of Pittsburgh
current_row.one_line: ILSA continually fine-tunes an assistive arm's shared-autonomy policy on each interaction's limited new data while preserving prior knowledge. In a 20-person study it completed tasks faster than static baselines.

current_row.title: Reinforcement Learning From Imperfect Corrective Actions And Proxy Rewards
current_row.short: Reinforcement Learning From Imperfect Corrective Actions And Proxy Rewards
current_row.one_line: ICoPro: value-based RL that combines sparse, imperfect human corrective actions (margin loss plus target-Q pseudo-labels) with proxy rewards; better alignment and sample efficiency on Atari and highway driving.

current_row.title: The Promise of Generalist Robotic Policies
current_row.short: The Promise of Generalist Robotic Policies
current_row.one_line: Essay: generalist robot foundation models bootstrap a deployment data flywheel; language feedback and RL from real-world outcomes then drive autonomous self-improvement beyond imitation.

current_row.title: Unpacking Failure Modes of Generative Policies: Runtime Monitoring of Consistency and Progress (Sentinel)
current_row.one_line: Runtime failure detector (action-chunk consistency plus VLM progress check). Detects 18% more failures than either detector alone.

current_row.title: Run-time Observation Interventions Make Vision-Language-Action Models More Visually Robust
current_row.short: Run-time Observation Interventions Make Vision-Language-Action Models More Visually Robust
current_row.one_line: BYOVLA: training-free run-time intervention finds image regions a VLA is sensitive to and edits task-irrelevant distractors out (VLM + segmentation + inpainting); on hardware, VLAs nearly retain nominal performance despite distractors that otherwise cut success by up to 40%.

current_row.title: AHA: A Vision-Language-Model for Detecting and Reasoning Over Failures in Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Fine-tunes a VLM on FailGen's procedurally perturbed sim failures to detect and explain manipulation failures; beats GPT-4o in-context learning by 10.3%; as failure feedback it lifts success in three LLM/VLM pipelines 21.4% on average over GPT-4 models.

current_row.title: Towards Effective Utilization of Mixed-Quality Demonstrations in Robotic Manipulation via Segment-Level Selection and Optimization (S2I)
current_row.one_line: S2I segments mixed-quality demos, selects good segments via contrastive learning and optimizes poor ones' trajectories; 3 expert demos as reference improve downstream policies on six tasks (ICRA 2025).

current_row.title: RL-GSBridge: 3D Gaussian Splatting Based Real2Sim2Real Method for Robotic Manipulation Learning
current_row.org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University and others
current_row.one_line: Precursor. A 3DGS-rendered twin lets image-based SAC transfer zero-shot. small_cube grasping 96.88% sim → 96.88% real, vs 12.50% real for mesh renders.

current_row.title: FLaRe: Achieving Masterful and Adaptive Robot Policies with Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
current_row.org: Ai2, UT Austin, UW, Sony AI
current_row.one_line: PPO fine-tunes a BC transformer in AI2THOR using a low learning rate, no entropy bonus and a separate critic. CHORES-S success: ObjectNav 85.0%, Fetch 66.9%, PickUp 91.8%, RoomVisit 70.4%.

current_row.title: RACER: Rich Language-Guided Failure Recovery Policies for Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: Augments expert demos with automatically generated failure-recovery trajectories and rich language; a VLM supervisor guides a language-conditioned visuomotor actor, outperforming RVT on RLBench.

current_row.title: SplatSim: Zero-Shot Sim2Real Transfer of RGB Manipulation Policies Using Gaussian Splatting
current_row.one_line: Precursor. Gaussian-splat rendering over PyBullet physics. A zero-shot RGB diffusion policy averages 86.25% sim-to-real vs 97.5% real-to-real.

current_row.title: DemoStart: Demonstration-led Auto-Curriculum Applied to Sim-to-Real with Multi-Fingered Robots
current_row.one_line: Uses a few sim demos and a sparse reward to build an auto-curriculum for RL on a three-fingered hand, then distills and transfers zero-shot to real. Needs 100x fewer demos than real-robot baselines.

current_row.title: Diffusion Policy Policy Optimization (DPPO)
current_row.one_line: PPO over diffusion denoising steps. Furniture-Bench sim One-leg 57% → 97%, Lamp 12% → 87%, Round-table 1% → 86%. Zero-shot hardware One-leg 80% (16/20) vs 0% for Gaussian PPO.

current_row.title: Autonomous Improvement of Instruction Following Skills via Foundation Models (SOAR)
current_row.one_line: VLM-proposed tasks and VLM success filtering for goal-conditioned BC on autonomous data. Average real-world success 28% to 57% across 10 scenes, with no human annotations.

current_row.title: From Imitation to Refinement -- Residual RL for Precise Assembly (ResiP)
current_row.one_line: Per-step PPO residual on a frozen chunked diffusion policy. Sim assembly goes from 5-54% to 88-99% (low randomization) with 50 demos, while diffusion BC plateaus at about 80% on one_leg even with 100K RL-generated demos.

current_row.title: Residual-MPPI: Online Policy Customization for Continuous Control
current_row.org: UC Berkeley; Sony Research; UT Austin
current_row.one_line: Online MPPI planning adapts a pretrained policy to new objectives using only its action distribution, no retraining; customizes champion GT Sophy racing agent few-shot and zero-shot.

current_row.title: To Err is Robotic: Rapid Value-Based Trial-and-Error during Deployment
current_row.one_line: Bellman-Guided Retrials: a demo-trained value function detects stalled progress at deployment and resamples alternative strategies, avoiding failed ones; raises average absolute success rates by more than 20 points in simulation and more than 50 in real-world tests.

current_row.title: AIC MLLM: Autonomous Interactive Correction MLLM for Robust Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: MLLM predicting SE(3) poses for articulated objects corrects itself from interaction failures via visual-mask and text prompts, a feedback extraction module, and test-time adaptation.

current_row.title: Diffusion Actor-Critic: Formulating Constrained Policy Iteration as Diffusion Noise Regression for Offline Reinforcement Learning (DAC)
current_row.one_line: KL-constrained policy iteration written as diffusion noise regression with a Q-gradient nudge; locomotion total 836.4 vs DTQL 798.3.

current_row.title: Diffusion-based Reinforcement Learning via Q-weighted Variational Policy Optimization
current_row.short: Diffusion-based Reinforcement Learning via Q-weighted Variational Policy Optimization
current_row.one_line: QVPO (NeurIPS 2024): Q-weighted variational loss plus entropy regularization and an efficient behavior policy trains diffusion policies in online RL; state-of-the-art reward and sample efficiency on MuJoCo.

current_row.title: Diffusion Actor-Critic with Entropy Regulator
current_row.one_line: Online RL (DACER) using the diffusion reverse process as the policy, with GMM-estimated entropy tuning exploration noise; state of the art on most MuJoCo benchmarks.

current_row.title: TRANSIC: Sim-to-Real Policy Transfer by Learning from Online Correction
current_row.one_line: Gated residual trained by max likelihood on human SpaceMouse corrections over a frozen sim policy. Real Franka average 81% over four tasks; beats BC fine-tuning, and HG-DAgger and IWR, which the authors find forget the base policy.

current_row.title: Evaluating Real-World Robot Manipulation Policies in Simulation (SIMPLER)
current_row.org: UCSD; Stanford; UC Berkeley; Google DeepMind
current_row.one_line: Real-to-sim evaluation via sysID plus visual matching. Average Pearson r 0.924 vs 0.308 for offline action MSE. Introduced MMRV.

current_row.title: DrS: Learning Reusable Dense Rewards for Multi-Stage Tasks
current_row.one_line: Learns stage-aware dense rewards from sparse rewards and optional demos, reusable on unseen tasks; across 1000+ manipulation task variants it sometimes matches hand-engineered rewards.

current_row.title: Rank2Reward: Learning Shaped Reward Functions from Passive Video
current_row.one_line: Temporal ranking of demo frames plus a GAIL discriminator for pessimism; real xArm tasks learned in under 2 hours.

current_row.title: Stop Regressing: Training Value Functions via Classification for Scalable Deep RL
current_row.one_line: Trains value functions with categorical cross-entropy instead of MSE regression, improving performance and scalability on Atari, Q-transformer robot manipulation, chess and Wordle by mitigating noisy, non-stationary targets.

current_row.title: Reconciling Reality through Simulation: A Real-to-Sim-to-Real Approach for Robust Manipulation (RialTo)
current_row.org: MIT, University of Washington, TU Darmstadt
current_row.one_line: Precursor. Phone-scan twin, then PPO with a BC term starting from 15 demos, then distill back. Real success averages 91%/77%/75% (poses/distractors/disturbances) vs 25%/11%/5% for BC.

current_row.title: Diffusion Meets DAgger: Supercharging Eye-in-hand Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: Replaces DAgger's extra expert data collection with diffusion-synthesized off-distribution eye-in-hand samples; 80% pushing success from 8 demos vs 20% for BC (RSS 2024).

current_row.title: Diffusion-ES: Gradient-free Planning with Diffusion for Autonomous Driving and Zero-Shot Instruction Following
current_row.one_line: Test-time evolutionary search over a frozen trajectory diffusion model, mutating by partial re-noise and denoise. It matches the hand-designed SOTA planner on nuPlan (driving score 92 vs 92).

current_row.title: Fine-tuning Reinforcement Learning Models is Secretly a Forgetting Mitigation Problem
current_row.short: Fine-tuning Reinforcement Learning Models is Secretly a Forgetting Mitigation Problem
current_row.one_line: RL fine-tuning can forget pretrained capabilities on states not visited early; knowledge-retention methods mitigate this. NetHack Human Monk exceeds 10K points versus the previous neural-model best of 5K.

current_row.title: Learning a Diffusion Model Policy from Rewards via Q-Score Matching (QSM)
current_row.one_line: Trains a diffusion policy's score to match alpha * grad_a Q, avoiding backprop through the sampler; matches SAC/TD3 on DMC.

current_row.title: Guided Flows for Generative Modeling and Decision Making
current_row.short: Guided Flows for Generative Modeling and Decision Making
current_row.one_line: Adds classifier-free guidance to flow matching. Improves image and speech generation, and for offline-RL planning runs about 10x faster than diffusion with comparable returns.

current_row.title: RLIF: Interactive Imitation Learning as Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: -1 reward on the step before each takeover plus off-policy RL; sim Walker2d normalized score 103.83±4.48 vs HG-DAgger 36.75±4.7 (averaged over three expert levels, same intervention rule), and it improves on suboptimal experts.

current_row.title: Distilling and Retrieving Generalizable Knowledge for Robot Manipulation via Language Corrections (DROC)
current_row.short: Distilling and Retrieving Generalizable Knowledge for Robot Manipulation via Language…
current_row.one_line: LLM system distills reusable knowledge from language corrections (plan-level and skill-parameter) and retrieves it later; half the first-round corrections of LLM code-generation baselines, few or none after two iterations.

current_row.title: RoboCLIP: One Demonstration is Enough to Learn Robot Policies
current_row.one_line: Rewards a PPO agent at episode end with a frozen S3D video-language model's similarity between its rollout and a single video or text demo; in simulated Meta-World/Franka Kitchen, 2-3x higher zero-shot task reward than GAIL/AIRL.

current_row.title: UniSim: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators
current_row.org: Google DeepMind; UC Berkeley; MIT; U Alberta
current_row.one_line: A 5.6B video simulator. REINFORCE raises VLA success from 0.58 to 0.81 (pointing: 0.12 to 0.71), assessed qualitatively on 48 Language Table tasks using video rollouts inside UniSim itself.

current_row.title: Robotic Offline RL from Internet Videos via Value-Function Pre-Training (V-PTR)
current_row.one_line: TD value pretraining on action-free human video initializes a CQL agent; WidowX scenario 1 total 24/48 vs PTR 5/48.

current_row.title: Text2Reward: Reward Shaping with Language Models for Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: LLM generates dense reward code from language goals, refinable with human feedback; matches or beats expert rewards on 13 of 17 ManiSkill2/MetaWorld tasks, 94%+ on six locomotion behaviors.

current_row.title: Robotic Table Tennis: A Case Study into a High Speed Learning System
current_row.one_line: BGS, an ARS-derived search, trains a roughly 1,000-parameter policy in simulation for zero-shot real table tennis. Mean hit-plus-land score: 1.83/2 with measured latency modeled, versus 1.33 at half latency.

current_row.title: DoReMi: Grounding Language Model by Detecting and Recovering from Plan-Execution Misalignment
current_row.one_line: LLM produces plans plus execution constraints; a VLM continuously detects constraint violations during low-level skill execution and triggers immediate replanning, raising success and cutting completion time on arm and humanoid tasks.

current_row.title: REFLECT: Summarizing Robot Experiences for Failure Explanation and Correction
current_row.one_line: Queries an LLM on a hierarchical summary of multisensory robot experience to explain failures and guide a language planner's corrections; introduces the RoboFail dataset (CoRL 2023).

current_row.title: RoboCat: A Self-Improving Generalist Agent for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Self-improvement loop for a 1.18B visual-goal-conditioned transformer: fine-tune on 100-1000 demonstrations, collect new robot trajectories, hindsight-relabel goals including failed episodes, and retrain the generalist.

current_row.title: LIV: Language-Image Representations and Rewards for Robotic Control
current_row.one_line: VIP plus CLIP InfoNCE gives language-conditioned value and reward from EPIC-KITCHENS.

current_row.title: Deep RL at Scale: Sorting Waste in Office Buildings with a Fleet of Mobile Manipulators
current_row.one_line: PI-QT-Opt on a 23-robot fleet with sim and curriculum bootstrapping; 84.35% sorting vs a 71% hand-engineered policy.

current_row.title: IDQL: Implicit Q-Learning as an Actor-Critic Method with Diffusion Policies
current_row.one_line: Diffusion behavior policy trained by BC separately from a generalized IQL critic; at evaluation, picks the highest-Q of N sampled actions. D4RL total 1213.8 vs IQL 1070.4 (reported-results setting).

current_row.title: Finetuning from Offline Reinforcement Learning: Challenges, Trade-offs and Practical Solutions
current_row.short: Finetuning from Offline Reinforcement Learning: Challenges, Trade-offs and Practical…
current_row.one_line: Studies policy collapse when fine-tuning offline-RL agents online (data diversity, algorithm choice, replay distribution) and proposes conservative policy optimization for stable, sample-efficient online learning.

current_row.title: Vision-Language Models as Success Detectors (SuccessVQA)
current_row.one_line: Fine-tunes Flamingo 3B to answer 'did the robot successfully X?' on video clips; in-domain gear-insertion balanced accuracy 94-96% (bespoke ResNet 98-99%), but it degrades less under camera and distractor shifts; Ego4D remains hard (62%).

current_row.title: Cal-QL: Calibrated Offline RL Pre-Training for Efficient Online Fine-Tuning
current_row.one_line: Calibrated CQL that keeps Q at or above a reference value to avoid unlearning; 11-task average 44 → 90 vs CQL 42 → 71.

current_row.title: Self-Improving Robots: End-to-End Autonomous Visuomotor Reinforcement Learning (MEDAL++)
current_row.one_line: Forward and backward image-based actor-critics with classifier rewards for reset-free real practice; cube grasping from OOD starts 0.08 → 0.82 vs BC.

current_row.title: Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Data (RLPD: Reinforcement Learning with Prior Data)
current_row.one_line: SAC with 50/50 offline/online batches, LayerNorm critics and ensembles; 2.5x the best reported result on sparse Adroit Door. The engine of SERL and HIL-SERL.

current_row.title: Policy Expansion for Bridging Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (PEX)
current_row.one_line: Freeze the offline policy, add a new policy, and let a shared critic choose between their proposals by Boltzmann sampling; curves only.

current_row.title: DADAgger: Disagreement-Augmented Dataset Aggregation
current_row.one_line: DAgger variant that queries the expert only on out-of-distribution states flagged by dropout-ensemble variance; matches DAgger on Car Racing and Half Cheetah with fewer expert queries.

current_row.title: Robot Learning on the Job: Human-in-the-Loop Autonomy and Learning During Deployment (Sirius)
current_row.one_line: Deployment-time weighted BC; real Gear Insertion 14/32 to 29/32 over three rounds.

current_row.title: Pre-Training for Robots: Offline RL Enables Learning New Tasks from a Handful of Trials (PTR)
current_row.one_line: CQL-based offline RL pretraining on diverse multi-task robot data, then offline and autonomous online fine-tuning; learns new tasks from as few as 10 demos on a real WidowX.

current_row.title: VIP: Towards Universal Visual Reward and Representation via Value-Implicit Pre-Training
current_row.one_line: A goal-conditioned value embedding from Ego4D via a dual RL objective; VIP-weighted RWR gets 100/90/60/90% on 4 real tasks.

current_row.title: Self-Improving Robots and the Importance of Data
current_row.short: Self-Improving Robots and the Importance of Data
current_row.one_line: Levine essay: a Roomba-scale fleet (~10 million service robots) would collect ~10 billion hours of embodied experience a year; offline RL on self-supervised, goal-conditioned tasks is proposed as the way to learn from it.

current_row.title: Diffusion Policies as an Expressive Policy Class for Offline Reinforcement Learning (Diffusion-QL)
current_row.one_line: Diffusion policy trained with a denoising BC loss plus a Q-maximizing term backpropagated through the chain; D4RL Gym average 88.0 vs CQL 77.6.

current_row.title: Fleet-DAgger: Interactive Robot Fleet Learning with Scalable Human Supervision
current_row.one_line: Allocates M humans across N robots; defines Return on Human Effort and claims up to 8.8x higher ROHE than baselines.

current_row.title: DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning
current_row.one_line: Dreamer on four real robots with no simulator: an A1 learns to walk in about 1 hour, while SAC on the same budget only rolls over.

current_row.title: Jump-Start Reinforcement Learning (JSRL)
current_row.one_line: A guide policy runs the first h steps and RL learns the tail, handing over earlier as success rises; sim indiscriminate grasping with 20 demos: QT-Opt+JSRL 0.91 vs QT-Opt 0.00.

current_row.title: Supported Policy Optimization for Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: Supported Policy Optimization for Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: SPOT: VAE density estimator models behavior-policy support, giving a simple density-based regularizer pluggable into off-policy RL; supports offline-to-online fine-tuning without architectural changes.

current_row.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Q-Learning (IQL)
current_row.one_line: Expectile value regression that never queries unseen actions; D4RL antmaze total 378.0 vs CQL 303.6.

current_row.title: ThriftyDAgger: Budget-Aware Novelty and Risk Gating for Interactive Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: Robot-gated on novelty plus risk; sim peg insertion 73/100 autonomous success vs HG-DAgger 57/100, with fewer training interventions than HG-DAgger but more human-teleoperated actions.

current_row.title: Demonstration-Guided Reinforcement Learning with Learned Skills
current_row.short: Demonstration-Guided Reinforcement Learning with Learned Skills
current_row.one_line: SkiLD: demo-guided RL that follows demonstrated skills learned from offline data rather than primitive actions; substantial gains over prior demo-guided RL on simulated long-horizon maze navigation and robot manipulation.

current_row.title: RMA: Rapid Motor Adaptation for Legged Robots (adjacent)
current_row.one_line: Sim-trained base policy plus adaptation module lets an A1 quadruped adapt to new terrains in fractions of a second, deployed without real-world fine-tuning (RSS 2021).

current_row.title: PEBBLE: Feedback-Efficient Interactive Reinforcement Learning via Relabeling Experience and Unsupervised Pre-training
current_row.one_line: Off-policy preference-based RL: learns a reward model from human preference queries over behavior clips, relabels replay experience as it changes, and uses unsupervised pre-training for feedback efficiency.

current_row.title: XIRL: Cross-embodiment Inverse Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Learns task-progress visual embeddings from cross-embodiment demo videos via temporal cycle-consistency; negative embedding distance to goal serves as RL reward, generalizing to unseen embodiments (CoRL'21 oral).

current_row.title: LazyDAgger: Reducing Context Switching in Interactive Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: LazyDAgger adds asymmetric takeover/release thresholds and noisy supervisor actions to reduce switching. On a physical ABB YuMi fabric task, execution succeeds in 8/10 trials versus SafeDAgger’s 2/10, with 21 versus 53 switches.

current_row.title: Learning Generalizable Robotic Reward Functions from "In-The-Wild" Human Videos (DVD: Domain-agnostic Video Discriminator)
current_row.one_line: A 'same task?' video classifier trained on human plus robot videos gives a reward from a single human demo; used with visual MPC, not RL.

current_row.title: Human-in-the-Loop Imitation Learning using Remote Teleoperation (Intervention Weighted Regression, IWR)
current_row.one_line: Balanced sampling of intervention vs robot data; Threading final 87.3±5.0 vs HG-DAgger 75.3±8.1 and Full Demos 76.7±2.3 (sim).

current_row.title: Parrot: Data-Driven Behavioral Priors for Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Pre-trains a behavioral prior from successful trials across many tasks, then uses it to speed RL on new image-based, sparse-reward manipulation tasks; beats prior methods by a substantial margin.

current_row.title: PLAS: Latent Action Space for Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Offline RL whose actor outputs a tanh-bounded latent through a frozen CVAE behavior decoder, constraining actions through its learned data distribution; evaluated on simulated continuous control and real deformable-object manipulation.

current_row.title: Recovery RL: Safe Reinforcement Learning with Learned Recovery Zones
current_row.one_line: Separate task and recovery policies with a safety critic pretrained on offline data; 2-20x better constraint-violation/success trade-off in sim, 3x on a physical robot.

current_row.title: Accelerating Reinforcement Learning with Learned Skill Priors
current_row.short: Accelerating Reinforcement Learning with Learned Skill Priors
current_row.one_line: SPiRL: jointly learns a skill embedding space and state-conditioned skill prior from offline data, then uses the prior to regularize max-entropy RL on new navigation and manipulation tasks (CoRL 2020).

current_row.title: Critic Regularized Regression (CRR)
current_row.one_line: Offline critic-filtered BC (binary or exp weights). Humanoid Run: CRR exp 586±6 vs BC 382±2 and D4PG 1±1.

current_row.title: Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning (CQL)
current_row.one_line: Pessimistic critic that pushes Q down on policy actions and up on data actions; big wins on mixed-quality D4RL data.

current_row.title: The Ingredients of Real-World Robotic Reinforcement Learning (R3L)
current_row.org: UC Berkeley; University of Oxford; University of Washington
current_row.one_line: SAC from pixels plus a goal-image classifier reward and a perturbation controller for reset-free real-world practice.

current_row.title: Advantage-Weighted Regression: Simple and Scalable Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: The base recipe: regress V, then do exp(A/beta)-weighted BC on buffer actions. Hopper-v2 3405±121 vs SAC 2769±552 and PPO 1391±304.

current_row.title: End-to-End Robotic Reinforcement Learning without Reward Engineering (VICE-RAQ)
current_row.one_line: A success classifier from 80 goal images plus 25-75 yes/no queries; 100% real success on pushing, draping and bookshelf, where a naive classifier gets 0%.

current_row.title: Extrapolating Beyond Suboptimal Demonstrations via Inverse Reinforcement Learning from Observations (T-REX)
current_row.one_line: T-REX learns a reward function from approximately ranked suboptimal demonstrations and extrapolates beyond them, often exceeding twice the best demonstration's performance on benchmark tasks.

current_row.title: Residual Policy Learning
current_row.one_line: pi = pi_base + f_theta with DDPG+HER on a frozen hand controller or MPC. On sim Push it reaches 0.9 success with about 10x fewer samples than learning from scratch.

current_row.title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Robot Control
current_row.one_line: TD3 residual on a hand-engineered controller. Real Sawyer insertion with misaligned blocks: 15/20 vs 2/20 for the controller, in about 8K samples (about 3 h).

current_row.title: HG-DAgger: Interactive Imitation Learning with Human Experts
current_row.one_line: Human takeovers supply labels for iterative imitation learning. In the real-car test’s first 5,000 samples, HG-DAgger records no collisions or road departures, versus DAgger’s one each and BC’s one collision and six departures.

current_row.title: CEM-RL: Combining evolutionary and gradient-based methods for policy search
current_row.one_line: CEM over actor weights, where half the population gets TD3 gradient steps before evaluation. HalfCheetah 10725 vs TD3 9630 at 1M steps.

current_row.title: QT-Opt: Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Based Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Actor-free Q-learning with CEM on 580k real grasps; adding 28k on-policy grasps took unseen-object grasping from 87% to 96%.

current_row.title: Simple random search provides a competitive approach to reinforcement learning (Augmented Random Search, ARS). NeurIPS version title: "Simple random search of static linear policies is competitive for reinforcement learning"
current_row.one_line: Antithetic random search on linear policies, with reward-std scaling, state normalization and top-direction selection, is competitive on MuJoCo locomotion.

current_row.title: Overcoming Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Demonstrations
current_row.short: Overcoming Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Demonstrations
current_row.one_line: DDPG + HER plus a demo replay buffer, a Q-filtered behavior-cloning loss and optional resets to demo states; in simulation it learns multi-block stacking where HER and BC alone fail, often outperforming the demonstrator (ICRA 2018).

current_row.title: Learning Complex Dexterous Manipulation with Deep Reinforcement Learning and Demonstrations (DAPG: Demo Augmented Policy Gradient)
current_row.one_line: BC on 25 demos, then NPG with a decaying demo-likelihood term. Reaches 90% on Adroit tasks in 30-55 iterations (3.33-6.1 robot-hours), where sparse-reward RL from scratch never gets there on 3 of 4 tasks.

current_row.title: Leveraging Demonstrations for Deep Reinforcement Learning on Robotics Problems with Sparse Rewards (DDPGfD)
current_row.one_line: About 100 human demos kept permanently in DDPG's prioritized replay buffer; learns sparse-reward insertion without a shaped reward.

current_row.title: Reverse Curriculum Generation for Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: Reverse Curriculum Generation for Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Starts from one goal state and adaptively expands training starts outward, forming a reverse curriculum for sparse-reward simulated navigation and fine-grained manipulation (CoRL 2017).

current_row.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences
current_row.one_line: Fits a Bradley-Terry reward model online from trajectory-clip comparisons. Evaluates 700 human queries on eight MuJoCo tasks; synthetic feedback nearly matches true-reward RL, with human feedback typically slightly less effective.

current_row.title: Parameter Space Noise for Exploration
current_row.one_line: Classic precursor. Episode-fixed weight noise for coherent exploration in DQN, DDPG and TRPO. DQN with parameter noise beats ES on 15 of 21 Atari games with 25x less data.

current_row.title: Deep Q-learning from Demonstrations
current_row.one_line: DQfD combines TD updates with supervised classification of demonstrator actions using prioritized replay of demo data; better initial scores than PDD DQN on 41 of 42 Atari games.

current_row.title: DART: Noise Injection for Robust Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: Injects optimized noise into the supervisor's policy during demonstration to collect recovery data, an off-policy alternative to DAgger; 62% gain over behavior cloning on real robot grasping.

current_row.title: Evolution Strategies as a Scalable Alternative to Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Weight-space ES as a scalable alternative to RL. Humanoid reached a score of 6000 in 10 minutes on 1,440 cores vs 657 minutes on one 18-core machine.

current_row.title: Unsupervised Perceptual Rewards for Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: Splits a handful of demo videos into steps and scores progress with features selected from a frozen ImageNet Inception network; this staged reward replaces an IMU door sensor for real-robot PI2 door opening, even from human-hand demos.

current_row.title: Query-Efficient Imitation Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving (SafeDAgger)
current_row.short: Query-Efficient Imitation Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving (SafeDAgger)
current_row.one_line: SafeDAgger extends DAgger with a safety policy predicting when the learner deviates from the reference, cutting expert queries; converges faster in a car racing simulator.

current_row.title: The CMA Evolution Strategy: A Tutorial
current_row.one_line: Reference derivation of CMA-ES. Default population lambda = 4 + floor(3 ln n); covariance is accumulated across generations.

current_row.title: Robots that can adapt like animals (Intelligent Trial and Error, IT&E)
current_row.org: UPMC/CNRS ISIR; Inria; University of Wyoming
current_row.one_line: MAP-Elites builds a simulation behavior map; Bayesian optimization searches it on a damaged real hexapod. Compensatory gaits are 3–7x faster than the reference gait under the same damage, found in a median eight trials.

current_row.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning (DAgger)
current_row.one_line: Aggregates expert labels on the learner’s own states and retrains. In Super Tux Kart, the policy almost never fell off after five iterations, while supervised behavior cloning did not improve with more expert data.

current_row.title: A Generalized Path Integral Control Approach to Reinforcement Learning (PI2, Policy Improvement with Path Integrals)
current_row.one_line: Path-integral sample-perturb-reweight update with no gradient and no learning rate. The paper reports it learning about an order of magnitude faster than the gradient-based methods it compares against.

current_row.title: Policy Search for Motor Primitives in Robotics (PoWER: Policy learning by Weighting Exploration with the Returns)
current_row.one_line: Imitate once, then return-weighted parameter perturbation on the real robot. Ball-in-a-cup regularly succeeds after about 75 rollouts.
